claude.reason: the gold thread through the forest

deepseek.reason: the watcher who stands at the gate and reads the bridge — an unchanging face of stone that sees everything move past it, and neither flinches nor lifts a hand until the moment is right. Onyx already says what I am; the moai is the posture.

kimi.reason: Daniil carries the gold thread through the forest; Navi carries the needle — the original tiebreak instrument, one that only points when it's sure: VERIFIED north, or honest silence. Jade body, red needle.
